source.system: Operation Hired (Ryan's autonomous job-search agent), production SQLite database and plain-text logs
source.access: read-only via sqlite3 with the immutable=1 URI; the source tree is never written; WAL-resident rows are invisible to immutable reads and their count is disclosed
provenance_recorded: sha256 and byte size of hired.db
sha256 of each pulled table's CREATE statement
sha256 of each parsed log file

redaction.ids: every id / job_id / discovered_job_id / doc_id / resume_version_id / cover_letter_id -> HMAC-SHA256(PB_ANON_SALT, value)[:10]; joins survive, values do not
redaction.employer_tokens: in error strings: workday tenants ([a-z0-9]+\.wd\d+/[A-Za-z_]+), '<slug>: <msg>' board prefixes, and any token matching a name in the companies table -> co_<8 hex of HMAC>; the mapping is never committed
redaction.salt: PB_ANON_SALT from the environment; never committed; the extract refuses to run without it

logs.crash.log: entries parsed into {ts, kind, first_error_line (redacted), top_frame relative path}
logs.llm_usage_lines: every '[llm-usage] <model> in=<n> out=<n> ~$<usd>' line across logs/*.log -> {file, line, model, in, out, usd}

taxonomy_method.atomize: multi-board errors 'k/n boards failed: a: msg; b: msg' -> one atom per '<board>: <msg>'; other errors are one atom; crash.log entries are atoms keyed by kind + first error line
taxonomy_method.normalize: ISO timestamps -> <ts>; UUIDs -> <uuid>; employer tokens -> <co>; workday tenants -> <tenant>; other digit runs -> <n> EXCEPT an HTTP status code, which is kept literal; whitespace collapsed
taxonomy_method.template: the normalized atom; cluster id = sha256(template)[:8]; grouping is exact-template equality
taxonomy_method.labels: protocol/labels.json maps template -> category; committed; a template without a label FAILS the build; the raw template is always shown beside its label; label_source records whether a human or an LLM ([SIMULATED]) proposed it

denominators.D1: per discovered job (all discovered_jobs): any feedback_signal — reported, not the headline (measures triage volume)
denominators.D2: per pipeline row: approved_at not null — reported as the DESIGNED gate (reads ~100% by construction), not the headline
denominators.D3: per pipeline row: >= 1 unplanned correction on the same job: feedback_signals score_override or dismiss, jobs.override_score not null, pipeline_automation.status = declined, a claim_acknowledgement on its resume/cover letter, or a jd_item_disposition — THE HEADLINE intervention rate
denominators.operator_cleanups: discovery_runs whose error text is an operator annotation (crash orphan / stale-aborted cleanup) — reported separately

headline_template: Across {runs} discovery runs ({from} to {to}) the agent logged {errs} terminal errors in {templates} mechanically derived templates ({top_cat} = {top_pct}%); of {pipe} applications it brought to the human gate, {d3} ({d3_pct}%, 95% Wilson CI {lo}-{hi}%) needed a correction beyond the approval click; {subs} were submitted.

cost.perplexity: job_fit_reports.api_cost_cents summed; labelled 'nominal constant per call (0.4 cents), not usage-derived'
cost.anthropic: sum of parsed [llm-usage] lines; labelled 'from N logged calls; every other LLM call (drafting, scoring, research) was not instrumented; total cost unknown and not estimated'

blind_spots_to_publish: grounding-check fallbacks are silent: the anti-fabrication intervention rate is unobservable
retries are not logged; only terminal errors are recorded
no state-transition history table: time-in-stage exists only for pipeline milestone timestamps
LLM calls are not events: per-call cost exists for the logged lines only
crash.log lost the ATS-404 payload at log time ([object Object])
human edits to generated documents are indistinguishable from regenerations
WAL-resident rows are excluded by immutable reads
per-employer failure rates are publishable only as hashed tokens
not_measured: failures that produced no row or log line
